title: Panel unveils 10 guiding principles in campaign to revive the Earth
claim: UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration partners developed ten guiding principles for restoration to maximise net gain for native biodiversity and ecosystem health, cautioning that introducing non-native species can cause further degradation and that restoration must be tailored to local site conditions.
evidence_text: UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration partners, through a consultative process involving more than 400 experts, developed ten principles for ecosystem restoration to create a shared vision and increase the likelihood of achieving the highest level of ecological recovery possible. The principles caution that introducing trees or other species not native to the local environment can lead to further degradation, underscoring that restoration needs to be tailored to local site conditions rather than applying generic planting approaches.
